title: Kestrel and the Cipher
author: C. M. Sterling
blurb: Juniper Ravensworth, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
